name: Okabe Co., Ltd.
summary: Okabe Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells construction and civil engineering products in Japan, North America, and internationally. It offers temporary construction products, such as clamps, scaffolding, inserts for scaffolding, temporary pass, and safety products; concrete formwork products, including separator, cone, form tie, flat rib, overtightening restrainer, corner fastener, panel adjuster, slab jointer, bottom pipe supporting hook, and leakage cover; items for h-beam, sheet pile method, insulation, and other formwork; water stop/disposal products; insert and rooftop protection products; and chamfers.
